description: Pick the right chart for the user's data + question, then render it locally via the flint-chart MCP server. Alex — ACT Edition plugin.

authors.name: Microsoft Corporation
authors.role: flint-chart authoring skill body (forked from microsoft/flint-chart/agent-skills/flint-chart-author) + flint-chart-mcp npm package

frontmatter.description: Distill the one-sentence Big Idea, story arc, audience, and style stance for a chart BEFORE picking a chart type. Reads the surrounding docs / prose / ticket for an existing Big Idea first, then helps the user articulate one via a 3-question elicitation ladder if none is found. Asks whether the user wants a TRADITIONAL (safe) or INNOVATIVE (higher-impact, higher-risk) treatment. Use before invoking the flint-chart skill or the /render-chart prompt whenever the user's ask is 'chart this', 'visualize', 'make a chart', 'show the data', or when framing is unclear.

Use when the user wants to visualize data — from 'which chart should I use?' to 'render this'. Helps pick the right chart from the analytical question (comparison / trend / distribution / relationship / proportion / flow / KPI), then authors a ChartAssemblyInput and renders via the flint-chart-mcp server (Vega-Lite / ECharts / Chart.js). Transform data before Flint; style tweaks after Flint.

Pick the right chart for the user's data + question, then author and render it via the flint-chart-mcp server. Loads the chart-big-idea skill for framing, then the flint-chart skill for selection and rendering.

mcp.merge: additive — merge the 'flint' entry into any existing server map; overwriting the file destroys the user's other servers
mcp.notes: VS Code does NOT read a workspace-root .mcp.json — that is the Claude Code convention. Same 'servers' schema, different path, and VS Code reports no error because it reads no file at all. GitHub Copilot CLI differs twice over: different path AND a different top-level key ('mcpServers', not 'servers'), so a pasted 'servers' block fails just as silently; prefer its '/mcp add' command. Version pin: public npm 'latest' is 0.4.0 (published 2026-07-24), but this pin stays at ^0.2.2 until the bump can be verified end-to-end — see the Unreleased section of CHANGELOG.md. When checking versions, confirm 'npm config get registry' first: a corporate mirror can report a stale 'latest' that is not the public one.

settings.role: registers the local/ skill + prompt discovery roots
settings.merge: additive — merge these two keys into any existing settings.json; never disable VS Code's default roots, since an adopter's own skills and prompts live there
settings.notes: VS Code discovers skills in .github/skills/ and prompts in .github/prompts/ but does not search their subfolders, so this plugin's local/ install paths load nothing without these keys — silently, with no error, the same failure mode as the .mcp.json path trap. Alex ACT Edition heirs >=3.x already register these roots and can skip this asset.

handoff_flow: load chart-big-idea skill → Step 0 (read surrounding context) → Steps 1-5 (Big Idea → arc → audience → style → Brief)
load flint-chart skill → §0.2 selection constrained by the Brief → §0.4 Flint-coverage check
render via flint MCP server (create_chart_view | render_chart | validate_chart | compile_chart)

prerequisites.mcp_host: VS Code Copilot 1.118+ | Claude Desktop | Cursor | GitHub Copilot CLI | any MCP stdio client
prerequisites.vscode_settings: On a plain VS Code workspace (no Alex ACT Edition), the assets.settings keys must be present or the local/ install paths are never discovered.
